title: Insertion sort reference solution
answer:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) { int a[]={5,2,4,1}; size_t n=sizeof a/sizeof a[0]; for(size_t i=1;i<n;++i) { int key=a[i]; size_t j=i; while(j>0 && a[j-1]>key) { a[j]=a[j-1]; --j; } a[j]=key; } for(size_t i=0;i<n;++i) printf("%d%c",a[i],i+1==n?'\n':' '); return 0; }
